title: GunPoint cross-dataset validation of redundant Q.ANT readout
research_question: Does the three-head redundant Q.ANT readout improvement from TwoLeadECG transfer to GunPoint without target-specific architecture search?
hypothesis: On the frozen GunPoint adaptation used in Exp012, averaging three independently parameterized Q.ANT-compatible readout heads will reduce mean reference/Q.ANT disagreements relative to a single head while retaining Q.ANT TEST accuracy.
rationale: Exp017 supported redundant readout on TwoLeadECG. Exp012 already established a frozen Alpha4-style GunPoint adaptation, allowing a clean cross-dataset intervention test without searching GunPoint TEST for a new topology.

dataset.name: GunPoint
dataset.input_adaptation: deterministic center crop 150→144 (drop 3 samples from each end)

candidates.redundant3: three independently parameterized Q.ANT Fourier/KAN heads 144→2; arithmetic mean of logits in reference and Q.ANT inference

success_criteria: Supported if redundant3 has strictly fewer mean reference/Q.ANT disagreements than control and mean Q.ANT accuracy >= control - 0.01.
promotion_rule: If supported, redundant readout becomes a validated cross-dataset PNN-v1 compatibility principle; architectural promotion still requires an explicit model revision proposal.
hardware_boundary: Q.ANT CPU/software simulation only; no physical photonic hardware performance claim.
